answer.reason: The verses tell of this Mary watching the crucifixion, seeing where Jesus was laid, and going to the sepulchre.

clauses.english: watched where Jesus was laid in the sepulchre
clauses.quote: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses beheld where he was laid.

clauses.english: went to the sepulchre at dawn on the first day of the week
clauses.quote: came Mary Magdalene and the other Mary to see the sepulchre.

clauses.english: told the apostles what had happened at the sepulchre
clauses.quote: Mary Magdalene and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James

doubts: MAT 27:56 and MRK 15:40 only place her among the women watching the crucifixion, which the summary already covers in part; left out as a separate clause.
LUK 24:10 names Mary the mother of James, presumed to be the same Mary as the other verses.
The quote for the third clause is trimmed from LUK 24:10 and is not an exact contiguous quote if the original differs; verse text is 'It was Mary Magdalene and Joanna, and Mary the mother of James'.
